headword: {骨格標本|こっかくひょうほん}

definitions.gloss: skeletal specimen; mounted skeleton (for study or display)
definitions.explanation: A prepared and often reassembled skeleton used as a specimen for biology study, education, or museum display. Common examples include animal skeletons in natural history museums and small-animal or human-anatomy skeletons in school biology classrooms.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{骨格|こっかく}→骨格：06233_kokkaku⟧ (skeletal frame, skeleton) and ⟦{標本|ひょうほん}→標本：13174_hyouhon⟧ (specimen, sample). A ⟦{標本|ひょうほん}→標本：13174_hyouhon⟧ is a preserved biological specimen used for study or display.

USAGE:
Used in the context of museums, biology labs, classrooms, and scientific research. Paired naturally with verbs like ⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ (to prepare), ⟦{組|く}み{立|た}てる→組み立てる：04661_kumitateru⟧ (to assemble), and ⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to exhibit).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {骨格標本|こっかくひょうほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to prepare a skeletal specimen
- {骨格標本|こっかくひょうほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}み{立|た}てる→組み立てる：04661_kumitateru⟧: to assemble a mounted skeleton
- {骨格標本|こっかくひょうほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to exhibit a skeletal specimen
- ⟦{恐竜|きょうりゅう}→恐竜：10428_kyouryuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{骨格標本|こっかくひょうほん}: dinosaur skeleton (as a museum exhibit)
- {人体|じんたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{骨格標本|こっかくひょうほん}: human skeletal specimen

- ⟦{標本|ひょうほん}→標本：13174_hyouhon⟧: specimen — the general term; {骨格標本|こっかくひょうほん} is one specific type
- ⟦{剥製|はくせい}→剥製：27683_hakusei⟧: taxidermy mount — a stuffed animal specimen with skin and fur, contrasted with {骨格標本|こっかくひょうほん} which shows only the bones
